ambient: The fridges cycle off. The silence is much louder than they were.
The security camera turns to look at you, and keeps turning.
Outside, a car goes past playing a song you were about to remember.
description: A corner shop with the lights off and the fridges still running, which you're certain you have bought something in. The stock is all one product, shelved with enormous care. The till is open and full. You aren't going to take any of it, and the not-taking is the most exhausting thing you have ever done.
name: The Shop, After Hours

looks: Full, and counted, and counted again by someone who left.
The notes are the right colour and the wrong size.
objects.name: the till

looks: Every box is the same box. The label is a photograph of the shelf you're looking at.
You read the ingredients. It's a list of everyone you have met.
It's slightly warm, the way a thing is warm when it has just been put down.
objects.name: the product

looks: The sign says CLOSED to you and OPEN to the street.
Locked, and the key is in it, on your side.
Someone outside is deciding whether to come in. They have been deciding a while.
objects.name: the door

weather: Outside the window it's raining, steadily, on a street that's completely dry.
